<svg aria-label="Double-slit geometry" role="img" viewBox="0 0 800 267" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
<rect fill="#fff" height="267" stroke="#e4e4e4" width="800" x="0" y="0" />
<rect fill="#494949" height="197" width="10" x="111" y="28" /><rect fill="#fff" height="10" width="10" x="111" y="85" /><rect fill="#fff" height="10" width="10" x="111" y="155" />
<line stroke="#888" stroke-dasharray="6 5" x1="116" x2="708" y1="125" y2="125" />
<line stroke="#b03737" stroke-width="2" x1="116" x2="708" y1="90" y2="56" />
<line stroke="#326dba" stroke-width="2" x1="116" x2="708" y1="160" y2="56" />
<line stroke="#404040" stroke-width="5" x1="708" x2="708" y1="30" y2="225" />
<line stroke="#888" stroke-width="1.5" x1="728" x2="728" y1="56" y2="124" /><path d="M723 60 l5 -7 5 7 M723 120 l5 7 5 -7" fill="none" stroke="#777" />
<line stroke="#555" x1="103" x2="103" y1="90" y2="160" /><path d="M99 96l4 -7 4 7 M99 155l4 7 4 -7" fill="none" stroke="#555" />
<line stroke="#555" stroke-dasharray="4 4" x1="116" y1="125" x2="708" y2="56" /><path d="M191 125 A75 75 0 0 0 190.5 116.3" fill="none" stroke="#444" />
<text font-size="18" x="74" y="87">S₁</text><text font-size="18" x="74" y="168">S₂</text><text font-size="18" x="125" y="145">O</text><text font-size="19" x="741" y="62">P</text><text font-size="19" x="741" y="129">C</text>
<text font-size="18" x="85" y="129">d</text><text font-size="18" x="737" y="92">x</text><text font-size="17" x="388" y="113">L</text>
<text font-size="18" x="193" y="112">θ</text><text fill="#a12b2b" font-size="19" x="390" y="68">r₁ = S₁P</text><text fill="#245e9f" font-size="19" x="403" y="197">r₂ = S₂P</text>
<text font-size="18" x="678" y="247">ฉาก</text><text font-size="18" x="35" y="249">สลิต</text><text fill="#666" font-size="17" x="306" y="153">แนวกลาง</text>
</svg><figcaption>ภาพเรขาคณิตแบบจำลอง: ระยะจริง L มากกว่าระยะสลิต d มาก</figcaption>
th.spacing:
<svg class="spacing-visual" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 760 125" role="img" aria-label="Adjacent bright-fringe positions from the central fringe: x m and x m plus one; their difference is Delta x">
      <defs><marker id="fringe-arrow-END" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" refX="3" refY="3" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0 L6 3 L0 6Z" fill="#333" /></marker></defs>
      <rect x="48" y="4" width="664" height="40" rx="5" fill="#192521" />
      <g fill="#8ce0af"><rect x="103" y="12" width="10" height="24" rx="4" /><rect x="232" y="12" width="10" height="24" rx="4" /><rect x="361" y="12" width="10" height="24" rx="4" /><rect x="490" y="12" width="10" height="24" rx="4" /><rect x="619" y="12" width="10" height="24" rx="4" /></g>
      <g font-family="Arial, Noto Sans Thai, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#222" text-anchor="middle"><text x="108" y="59">0</text><text x="237" y="59">1</text><text x="366" y="59">2</text><text x="495" y="59">3</text><text x="624" y="59">4</text></g>
      <path d="M108 64 V116 M366 64 V116 M495 64 V116" stroke="#777" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="2 4" />
      <path d="M112 77 H362" stroke="#444" stroke-width="1.5" marker-start="url(#fringe-arrow-END)" marker-end="url(#fringe-arrow-END)" />
      <path d="M112 96 H491" stroke="#444" stroke-width="1.5" marker-start="url(#fringe-arrow-END)" marker-end="url(#fringe-arrow-END)" />
      <path d="M370 113 H491" stroke="#245b5b" stroke-width="2" marker-start="url(#fringe-arrow-END)" marker-end="url(#fringe-arrow-END)" />
      <g font-family="Georgia, serif" text-anchor="middle" fill="#222" font-size="16"><text x="237" y="72" font-style="italic">x<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="12">B,m</tspan></text><text x="301" y="91" font-style="italic">x<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="12">B,m+1</tspan></text><text x="431" y="108" fill="#135b48" font-weight="bold">Δx</text></g>
    </svg><figcaption>เส้นยาววัดตำแหน่งจากแถบกลางถึงแถบอันดับ m และ m+1; เส้นสั้นวัดระยะห่าง Δx ระหว่างแถบติดกัน</figcaption>
